statement: One analyst inventoried the main ink-outlined drawings on the two manifest parts labelled 101v, without reading transcription words or other annotations. Panel A is canvas 1006250, shown at 1200 px width. Panel B is the leftmost panel of canvas 1006251 (101v part and 102r), inspected in a direct IIIF region 0,0,2800,3864 shown at 1400 px width. The middle and right panels showing 102r are excluded. Each rooted or stem-connected plant drawing is one object, not each separate leaf; jars are separate objects. Faint offsets, stains, the partial neighboring leaf visible left of panel A, and ordinary writing are not additional drawn objects. All labels are null: only locus identifiers f101v.1 through .18 marked @Lf and .19 through .28 marked paragraph were extracted from the verified ZL file. Their image-to-locus correspondence was not securely established without reading words; null means unresolved correspondence, not absence of a nearby inscription. The inventory provides visible features, not botanical identifications. Panel-specific descriptions and approximate positions are retained to distinguish objects across the two images; these free descriptions are not closed-vocabulary agreement features.

label_mapping_review.method: Bounded follow-up using the same two scan views, the verified ZL file's locus identifiers and non-lexical metadata only, and the general IVTFF format specification. No transcription words or other f101v picture annotations read. The regions below locate nearby visible writing without identifying its glyph sequence or assigning a ZL locus.
label_mapping_review.source_locations: Section 6.4, Tables 7–9, printed pp.21–22; section 6.10 printed p.26; section 7.2 printed p.28.
label_mapping_review.verified_structure: f101v.1–18 all have @Lf; f101v.19–27 are paragraph P0 loci and f101v.28 is Pc. No inline position comments occur on those loci. @ is a non-specific relative-position locator, not an image coordinate. The specification requires numerical order and warns that visual row/column ordering is not universally consistent. The page comment describes one logical page with f101v1, an interrupted paragraph across damaged creases, and two rows of labels above normal text; it supplies no label coordinates. Therefore a row-major numbering rule cannot be certified from these identifiers alone.
label_mapping_review.coordinate_system: Approximate [left, top, right, bottom] boxes in displayed-image pixels, with origin at top-left. A uses the 1200-wide full view of canvas 1006250. B uses the 1400-wide direct IIIF crop of canvas 1006251 region 0,0,2800,3864. These are writing-region estimates for later inspection, not segmentation masks or native-canvas coordinates. The free spatial records are not scored label assignments.

label_mapping_review.result: Twelve image-local writing regions are recorded, six with one spatial candidate and six explicitly ambiguous. Zero reliable ZL-locus assignments obtained; all object label values remain null. This is not a claim that only twelve labels exist. Completing the mapping requires a coordinate-to-locus key compatible with blind annotation.

provenance.order: Panel A jars top-to-bottom, then plants in approximate top-to-bottom rows left-to-right; then panel B plants in the same row order.
provenance.limits: Foldout-panel coverage and unresolved label mapping must be reviewed before using this inventory for picture-text tests. Counts refer to main connected drawings, with overlapping stems judged visually. No independent second reader was recruited.

features.shape: Panel A upper left: tall cylindrical vessel, open oval top, blue upper band and red lower body.
Panel A middle left: broad vessel with green top band, dark blue middle band and red base.
Panel A lower left: tall narrow red cylinder, dark upper band, flared base and open oval rim.
Top row left: branching green stem with five ragged rounded green clusters; pale horizontally extended knobbly root.
Top row centre-left: several pairs of downward-curving green blades, small outlined terminal cluster and tapered reddish root.
Top row centre-right: thin branching stem bearing seven pointed green cone-like forms with open looped bases; two orange-brown root lobes.
Top row right: upright stem with alternating green flared or bell-like forms, branching pale lower stem.
Middle row left: one large near-circular green blade with a pale curved slit, with three smaller green blades below around a pale rounded lower structure.
Middle row centre-left: three blunt serrated green blades on bending branches above a short brown root with several thin descending projections.
Middle row centre-right: two large toothed green blades sharing a stem and a long horizontal branched reddish root.
Middle row right: branched outline stem with several many-pointed starburst-like heads and a horizontal forked root. Heads are attached to one plant, not separate astronomical stars.
Bottom row left: upright green stem bearing many narrow pointed alternating leaflets, reddish forked root extending left.
Bottom row centre-left: separate pale stem with several tiers of long horizontal olive-green blades and a small pale/orange forked root.
Bottom row centre: fan-like lobed green blade and two green flared forms with pale scalloped tops; branches converge on small reddish root.
Bottom row centre-right: upright pale stem with several rounded lobed olive-green blades and a long curved pale root extending left.
Bottom row far right: separate cluster of long narrow rounded green blades converging at a common base near the page edge; lower attachment faint.
Panel B top row far left: narrow upright green blade or pair of blades above a dark brown tufted root, close to the gutter.
Top row left: two ascending ranks of red curved cup-like blades on a thin stem; ochre bulbous root with pointed extensions.
Top row centre-left: long stem with large alternating green tapering curved blades; bundle of fine brown root strands.
Top row centre-right: upright stem supporting green arching downward blades and a terminal tuft; long tan horizontal root.
Top row right: seven pointed lance-shaped green blades on a central stem; segmented horizontal tan root.
Middle row left: large round scalloped green blade and a narrow crescent-like side blade on stems sharing a small tan root.
Middle row centre-left: four rounded scalloped green heads on thin radiating stems above a short curved tan root.
Middle row centre: paired broad dark-green spade-like blades, two stems joining at a small dark/tan base.
Middle row centre-right: single pale green elongated oval blade with looped scalloped margin; thin stem and long slanting tan root.
Middle row right: several long curved pointed green blades arising above an oblique toothed tan root.
Bottom row left: five broad veined pointed green blades on a thin branching stem; short ochre root with hair-like projections.
Bottom row centre-left: branching upright green stem with many long narrow sharp blades; pale curved root and fine rootlets.
Bottom row centre: two large upright pointed green blades flanking a narrow red terminal spike; two rounded ochre root lobes with short projections.
Bottom row centre-right: upright branched stem with seven pointed ovate green leaves; thin uncoloured roots.
Bottom row far right: two thin stalks with alternating narrow green blades and three dark-blue rounded terminal forms with pale open centres; shared curved tan root.
